items.title: Joe Darensbourg and Minor "Ram" Hall Interview, 1957-04-18
items.q: The transcript contains no mention of Teddy by the interviewee. The mention of 'Teddy' appears in the [INTERVIEWER]'s turn ('I know I'm going to have a fight with Teddy...'), which is not the interviewee's statement.

ctx.x: crawfish next week, I'm going to. Yeah, I'm going to call by and have people

warning me about property. But I'm going to bring you this check. It's the last thing I do. I know I'm going to have a fight with Teddy because I used to get Teddy on a blue deal. No, you bring it by my house. Yeah, well, I'm going to say it if it
don't rain. Bring it by my house and then maybe you can give me some ideas about this
